answer: I would stop farms with oracle-signed location proof, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 654 pays 8502 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. A ripple of doubt is healthy, a dune of proof is required, and a mesa of patience is the price of a clean panel. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
